messages:
Olivia: Quick sanity check before I run the terraform & k8s changes to switch payments service to ExternalSecrets+VaultBridge tomorrow 06:00 UTC.
Olivia: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform-config/pull/1247
Olivia: Plan: 1) TF: add ExternalSecret resource + role binding, 2) k8s: replace k8s Secret manifest with ExternalSecret, 3) apply small Vault policy change. No intended downtime but want to validate rotation behavior.
Samir: Quick looked at the PR, main question: are we changing the vault path (secrets/data/payments/*)? If so need to update our kv-cache map.
Olivia: Not changing path, same path. Just switching sync mechanism. Diff snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payments-db-secret
  namespace: payments
spec:
  refreshInterval: "1m"
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-bridge
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: payments-db-secret
  data:
  - secretKey: username
    remoteRef: payments/db#username
  - secretKey: password
    remoteRef: payments/db#password
```
Jen: Two quick Qs: 1) Will rotation re-create the k8s secret (triggering pods to restart)? 2) Any RBAC changes I should be aware of?
Samir: 1) ExternalSecrets updates in-place by default; clients using projected volumes may see updates depending on mountBehavior. For our deployments most apps read env at start -> so no in-place reload. If we need zero-restart, consider using projected volume with `optional: true` or sidecar reloader.
Samir: 2) TF will add a service account + rolebinding that gives `get` on the vault-bridge CRD; PR contains the RBAC change.
Paul: Smoke test checklist before/after apply:
- kubectl -n payments get externalsecret payments-db-secret -o yaml
- kubectl -n payments get secret payments-db-secret -o yaml
- kubectl -n payments describe externalsecret payments-db-secret
- Check Vault audit logs for the read at the time of apply
- Keep `payments` deployment replicas at 2 so rolling restarts are safe
Olivia: Rollback plan?
Paul: Rollback = `terraform apply -var-file=prev.tfvars` (revert commit) then reapply legacy k8s Secret manifest from `manifests/legacy/payments-secret.yaml`. Keep PR #1247 branch until confirmed.
devops-bot: CI: build passed for PR #1247 :white_check_mark:
Jen: I'll review and do a quick RBAC pass later today. Assigning @Samir as codeowner for vault changes. :eyes:
Olivia: Thanks all — I'll wait for at least one approver + CI green, then schedule apply in the 06:00 UTC maintenance window and ping @oncall-bot to stand up monitoring.
oncall-bot: @oncall Pager duty oncall team notified for 06:00 UTC window
Olivia: I'll post a short post-apply note with `kubectl get secret` outputs and Vault audit check. :thumbsup:
